review_rationale: Source registration for 16.9.79-16.9.85: ERF, ERFC, ERFC_SCALED, EVENT_QUERY, EXECUTE_COMMAND_LINE, EXP and EXPONENT (batch190). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; EVENT_QUERY runtime facets are out of scope because event variables are coarrays; EXECUTE_COMMAND_LINE's assignment obligations are split from the processor-dependent values and text, with a guarded CMDMSG-unchanged plan; EXPONENT's result kind is checked on the expression and its IEEE special cases are guarded plans. Source accounting only.
